question:
Read the below statements marked as Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Mark the correct option:

Assertion (A): Humayun’s Tomb is considered a landmark in Mughal architecture.

Reason (R): It was the first garden-tomb constructed under the Mughals in India.

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Assertion (A): Humayun’s Tomb is considered a landmark in Mughal architecture.**

 
 
• Humayun's Tomb, located in **Delhi, India**, is one of the most iconic examples of **Mughal architecture**.
 
• The tomb was built in **1569–1570** by Humayun's widow, **Empress Bega Begum**, after his death.
 
• It is considered a landmark because it was the first structure to introduce the concept of a **charbagh (four-part garden)** in Mughal architecture, which later became a defining feature of Mughal monuments like the Taj Mahal. *Hence, the assertion is correct.*
 
 
 
• **Reason (R): It was the first garden-tomb constructed under the Mughals in India.**
 
 
• Humayun's Tomb is celebrated as the **first garden-tomb** constructed by the Mughals in India.
 
• The garden surrounding the tomb is inspired by the Persian-style garden layout, symbolizing paradise as described in **Islamic texts.**
 
• The tomb marked a significant shift in architectural style, combining **Persian and Indian influences** to create a new Mughal architectural vocabulary. *Hence, the reason is correct.*
 
 
 
• In this case, the reason (R) explains why the assertion (A) is true. The construction of Humayun's Tomb as the first garden-tomb under Mughal rule set a precedent for future Mughal architecture, solidifying its status as a landmark structure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• Construction was overseen by **Mirak Mirza Ghiyas**, a Persian architect, who brought expertise in Persian architectural design.

• **Impact of Persian Influence:**

 
 
• The Mughal rulers brought Persian architects and artisans, influencing the design and construction of their monuments.
 
• Humayun’s Tomb exemplifies this influence with its geometric symmetry, gardens, and intricate detailing.
 
 
 
• **Legacy of Humayun’s Tomb:**
 
 
• Its design inspired the construction of other Mughal-era monuments, making it a cornerstone of Indian architectural heritage.
 
• Its status as a UNESCO World Heritage Site helps preserve and showcase its historical importance.
